In Islamic tradition, the concept of "Fitrah" which refers to the pure and natural disposition of man, is considered an essential aspect of one's spiritual being. The name Samera, with its meaning of "the young one," can be seen as a reminder of the inherent purity and innocence, as well as the potential for growth and development, that is present in every individual, especially the young. Thus, the name Samera holds a deep and spiritual significance, emphasizing the importance of nurturing the youth and fostering their spiritual growth.
